text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif
text.tspan: Share of boys enrolled in primary school
Comparing net and gross enrollment ratios for boys in primary education. Net enrollment shows the share of
boys of primary school age (typically 6–11 years) who are enrolled, while gross enrollment includes all boys
regardless of age, expressed as a percentage of boys of the same age group.
